sources.label: Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoint used for pinned eth_call

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29 at Ethereum finalized block 25627228 (hash 0xe5c7dd15a7c6c8261957493e6f1dcbb72ec18688afccf6ac981748edb2f824e2; timestamp 2026-07-27T22:46:47Z). AlchemistV2 getSupportedYieldTokens() and getYieldTokenParameters() were read through an independent Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoint, and every registered yield token's expectedValue was aggregated by its on-chain underlying token: 80.2263% DAI, 15.9306% USDC, 0.3867% USDT, and 3.4564% FRAX. Each observed slice maps to its exact tracked stablecoin dependency. This is still a selected controller-local snapshot: Alchemix's L2 xalUSD representations, bridge/transmuter balances, AMO state, and any asset-wide reconciliation remain outside this slice, so the review does not claim a complete current alUSD balance sheet.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ethereum AlchemistV2 getSupportedYieldTokens() and getYieldTokenParameters().expectedValue aggregated by underlying token at Ethereum block 25627228
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All registered yield-token expected values in the observed Ethereum Alchemist were attributed to their on-chain underlying stablecoins; asset-wide L2, bridge, Transmuter, and AMO exposure remains unreconciled outside this selected slice.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is deposited non-custodially into AlchemistV2 and routed into registered Yearn/Aave yield strategies, so custody is contract-based rather than with a legal custodian; legal segregation and insolvency treatment do not apply at the protocol layer, and underlying stablecoin issuers retain their own custody and freeze postures.
